Senior Product Manager - Tech, Shipment Technologies
description:
**Description**
 Amazon’s Ship Tech (STS) team is responsible for key technology that enables planning, orchestration, and execution of transportation service to deliver billions of packages to Amazon.com customers globally. Our goal is to ensure the best delivery experience for customers across all geographies through a highly scalable, adaptive, and autonomous transportation network.
   

  

 We are looking for a product leader to be a part of our multi\-year effort to build the next generation of transportation planning and intelligence products. They will own critical Amazon services that leverage real\-time insights and predictive supply chain data across our entire network to drive automation, efficiency, and visibility. These services allow us to identify problems that could impact on\-time delivery, take proactive actions to mitigate network and package level problems, and keep customers informed on what is happening.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is capable of breaking down and solving complex problems, and has a strong will to get things done! You will work on real world problems on a global scale. You own your products end\-to\-end and influence the direction of our product and technology which impacts hundreds\-of\-millions of customers around the world. You are a hands\-on, pragmatic problem solver that easily balances trade\-offs between competing interests. You thrive in a fast\-moving team environment where you are able to juggle complex dependencies and requirements while producing optimal solutions.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Serve as the subject matter expert in transportation and logistics, control towers, and workflow automation, leveraging your deep domain knowledge to identify market trends, customer pain points, and opportunities for product enhancement
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including engineering, design, and customer success, to translate business requirements into technical specifications and drive the successful implementation of new product features and enhancements
* Develop a comprehensive product roadmap that aligns with the company's overall strategic objectives and effectively communicates it to stakeholders
* Continuously gather and analyze customer feedback, market intelligence, and industry insights to inform product decisions and ensure the delivery of high\-value solutions
* Manage the product lifecycle, from ideation to launch, ensuring that milestones are met, risks are mitigated, and the product is delivered on time and within budget


**Basic Qualifications**
* 6\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* Experience defining roadmap strategy and prioritizing deliverables for your team products
* Experience owning feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field or equivalent
* Experience in transportation operations and industry knowledge
* Experience understanding product and technical requirements and interfacing with Product/Technology teams
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
* Experience as a strong leader who can prioritize well, communicate clearly and effectively influence across cross\-functional teams
* Experience bringing technology products to market in a fast\-paced environment
* 6\+ years of working as a Technical Product Manager experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
* Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
* 5\+ years of supply chain operations and logistics experience

description:
**Description**
 Amazon Customer Service handles hundreds of millions of customer contacts each year across every Amazon business. Our Associate Experience organization owns the products, platforms, and AI systems that determine how Customer Service Associates (CSAs) onboard, learn, receive coaching, improve performance, and collaborate with AI to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.
   

  

 As Customer Service evolves, associates will increasingly solve sophisticated customer problems while AI automates routine interactions. This requires fundamentally reimagining how Amazon develops, supports, and continuously improves one of the world’s largest workforces.
   

  

 We are seeking a Principal Product Manager to define the long\-term vision for Associate Experience.
   

  

 This leader will establish the product strategy for the next generation of workforce experiences, spanning workforce intelligence, learning, coaching, performance management, associate communications, and future AI\-enabled experiences. You will define how Customer Service continuously learns from its workforce and transforms operational insights into better products, better associate experiences, and better customer outcomes.
   

  

 This is a highly strategic role requiring close partnership with Engineering, Science, Business Intelligence, UX, Operations, Routing, Workforce Planning, and senior leaders across Customer Service. The current platform does not exist in the form it needs to, providing a rare opportunity to define an entirely new product space.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 \> Define the long\-term vision and strategy for Associate Experience across Customer Service.
   

  

 \> Establish the multi\-year product roadmap spanning workforce development, workforce intelligence, and associate workspace experiences.
   

  

 \> Define how Customer Service measures, understands, and continuously improves workforce effectiveness.
   

  

 \> Drive product strategy across multiple engineering teams and partner organizations.
   

  

 \> Influence senior leadership on long\-term investments that improve associate capability, customer outcomes, and operational efficiency.
   

  

 \> Partner closely with Engineering, Applied Science, and Business Intelligence to transform operational insights into differentiated product capabilities.

* Bachelor's degree
* 8\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with AI/ML technologies

title: Sr. Product Manager, Returns, Worldwide Returns And Recommerce
description:
**Description**
 In the Worldwide Returns \& ReCommerce (WW R\&R) group at Amazon, we are dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ – zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects – to benefit our customers, company, and environment. We are an agile and inclusive organization that constantly innovates to create long\-term value by investing in our people and our planet, not simply focusing on the bottom line.
   

  

 WW R\&R includes business, product, operations, data, and software engineering teams, who together manage the lifecycle of returned and damaged products. In WW R\&R, you will partner across these teams to help customers get the most value out of Amazon’s products; improve the customer returns experience; and reduce defects, waste, and cost in reverse logistics processes. You will be a leader, a builder, and an owner, collaborating cross\-functionally with technical, operations, and business teams to design scalable and automated solutions to customer problems.
   

  

 Post Returns Experience is a charter of WW R\&R that is dedicated to providing the best\-in\-class post returns experience to customers, by building products that provide transparent and accurate information to customers thereby reducing customer contacts, improving customers' return behavior and enhancing the amazon fly wheel.
   

  

 We're looking for someone who has a passion for working in cross functional environment, strong communication skills (verbal \& written) in addition to proven product management experience. Join us if you want the opportunity to make a big impact in a quickly growing team that can make a big difference in the customers' journey with Amazon.
   

  

 Amazon is Earth’s most customer\-centric company and in WW R\&R, the Earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns \& ReCommerce.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities

 Create vision, product strategy, roadmap, and execution across a suite of return products to improve customer trust
   

  

 Develop worldwide features with huge customer\-facing and financial impact
   

  

 Work with technology, customer service, returns operations, retail etc. to develop a comprehensive solution to fulfil the returns CX.

title: Sr. Product Manager-Tech, DSP-DA Lifecycle Solutions
description:
**Description**
 The Sr. Product Manager\-Tech on the DSP\-DA LifeCycle Management (DALCM) team owns the end\-to\-end product strategy and execution for the critical milestones in the Delivery Service Partner (DSP) Delivery Associate (DA) lifecycle, including onboarding, off\-boarding, qualifications management, and status management across Amazon's global transportation network. The DSP program is the backbone of Amazon's last\-mile delivery network, operating in 22 countries with over 4,400 DSPs and 390,000\+ Delivery Associates.
   

  

 This role is responsible for customer experiences with considerable complexity, managing a unified data platform that serves as the single source of truth for associate information. This includes ownership of multiple concurrent product workstreams — DSP DA onboarding/off\-boarding workflow, DSP onboarding/off\-boarding experience, employment classification models, qualifications management, and DA data/metadata services — each requiring distinct technical approaches and stakeholder alignment. The Sr. Product Manager\-Tech is responsible for driving strategic goals that span multi\-million dollar cost savings, DSP satisfaction (CSAT), and DA sentiment — influencing the DA experience from the very first interaction with Amazon's systems. You will own the financial entitlement for your product area and be accountable for measurable improvements in onboarding speed, compliance automation, and operational efficiency for DSPs worldwide.
   

  

 We are in the early stages of a multi\-year initiative to overhaul much of the DA lifecycle experience from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity to invent and simplify at scale — redesigning foundational systems and workflows that touch hundreds of thousands of drivers globally. The role comes with significant investment backing and outsized influence in shaping what the next\-generation experience looks like.
   

  

 This is a global role requiring cross\-regional coordination across all regions where the DSP program is established or will be established, each with distinct compliance requirements, legal frameworks, hiring models, and payment structures. The role requires distinguishing between one\-way and two\-way door decisions to drive rapid experimentation where possible while ensuring appropriate rigor for irreversible choices. The Sr. Product Manager\-Tech serves as Voice of the Customer by generalizing requirements from diverse DSP DA personas across regions and use cases — working backward from their needs to reduce friction and time spent in onboarding and offboarding phases. Through direct engagement with DSPs, analysis of support tickets, and monitoring of operational health post\-launch, the Sr. Product Manager\-Tech gains insight that distinguishes between surface\-level requests and underlying problems that truly matter. The Sr. Product Manager\-Tech regularly drives product discussions with senior managers and Directors, producing clear documentation and contributing to OP1/OP2 planning cycles.
   

  

 We are seeking a PM with expertise and high judgment to determine the right goals, design long\-term solutions, and take the lead on initiatives independently while seeking direction when needed. This role operates in a space where problems, opportunities, and strategy are not always clearly defined, and the right candidate will thrive in that ambiguity.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Leading the build\-out of new external facing applications, products, features and tools.
* Owning the translation of business intent, customer needs, and/or technical direction into clear, concise, well\-documented business requirements or product backlog for one or more complex applications (or a product family) spanning one or more technical domains.
* Developing longer\-term (12 months or more) product roadmap, ensuring product development plans align with and support stakeholder business and application objectives.
* Communicate and collaborate cross\-functionally across multiple teams in operations, technology and planning to define strategic roadmaps while keeping the impact of the solution to all stakeholders in mind
* Creating and implementing data driven improvements to Amazon's transportation network
* Monitoring KPI’s to analyze their drivers and determine the level of investment needed


**About The Team**
 The team consists of engineers, product managers, and program managers. These functions roll up into a shared VP with a shared goal of delivering the most efficient experience for our transportation partners.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* 5\+ years of end to end product delivery experience
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive\-level prioritization and planning


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience bridging technical and business teams to collect and refine requirements, prioritize incoming work requests, and ensure all committed work is delivered on time
* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
